subject: Recap: Discovery call — Deployment mode needs & PoC plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, John Patel <john.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Discovery call — Deployment mode needs & PoC plan

Hi Samantha / John —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're all aligned and can move to a concrete PoC plan:

Key needs you mentioned:
- Regulated customer data for personalization workflows (PII + billing data) — primary concern is network isolation and auditability.
- Performance: target 50 concurrent inference req/s with p95 latency <200ms for text-generation flows.
- Cost sensitivity for high-volume embedding workloads.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + evidence of encryption at rest/in transit, audit logs.

Deployment options we discussed:
- Hosted API: fastest to try (no infra), but may not meet isolation/SLA requirements for regulated datasets.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool we manage for you (predictable throughput, private tenancy). Good middle ground for performance and isolation.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full network isolation and KMS control — fits regulatory needs but longer setup and infra coordination.

Proposed next steps / PoC options (pick one):
1) 4-week Dedicated PoC (recommended): we provision a dedicated capacity slice in your preferred region, run a staging workload with prefix caching and a 1:1 model profile. Success criteria below.
2) Hosted trial + security review: quick eval of latency/cost on a representative dataset while we work through SOC2 evidence and infra constraints.
3) Private VPC kickoff: for teams that need KMS and VPC right away — includes security & network runbook and a ~6 week timeline.

For any of the above, helpful to confirm:
- Success criteria (latency p95 target, throughput, quality metrics for embeddings/generation).
- Who will approve infra changes (network team / security / procurement).
- Target kickoff week.

I attached a short PoC trial plan and a mutual action plan to this thread. If you're aligned, I'll propose a kickoff date and loop in our infra/security leads.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: 20270803-acme-poc-trial-plan.pdf, mutual_action_plan_acme.xlsx

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Patel <john.patel@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery call — Deployment mode needs & PoC plan

Thanks Ben — good summary.

Quick answers:
- We're leaning toward Dedicated or Private (VPC) because of the regulated data in scope; Hosted API likely won't pass our security gate without additional isolation.
- Must have SOC 2 evidence and AES-256 encryption + audit logs for any environment we put data in.
- Timeline: target start of PoC by ~Aug 15 so we can evaluate before quarter end.
- Stakeholders: myself (product), John Patel (data infra) — John will own network approvals. I'll loop in security if we proceed.

Can you share the PoC success criteria and a proposed kickoff agenda?

Best,
Samantha
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
samantha.green@acme.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, John Patel <john.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-03T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery call — Deployment mode needs & PoC plan

Appreciate the quick reply, Samantha —

Below is a concrete PoC proposal based on your preference for Dedicated / Private:

Recommended: 4-week Dedicated PoC (can be extended to a VPC-backed staging if you need KMS/network handoff)
Proposed scope:
- Environment: Dedicated capacity in us-west-2 (isolated GPU pool).
- Workload: 2 representative production flows — generation for customer support templates and embedding index for retrieval.
- Data: redacted sample dataset that you control (we can provide tooling for masking).
- Team: Ben (sales, pilot owner), Marissa (solutions), Vivek Kulkarni (infra lead, Redwood) — I'll ask Marissa to coordinate infra details.

Success criteria (draft — please confirm):
- Latency: generation p95 < 200ms for the target prompt set.
- Throughput: sustained 50 req/s during peak scenario without degradation.
- Embedding quality: retrieval MAP >= baseline (we'll run a short eval).
- Cost target: estimated cost for production profile < $1,200 / million tokens (draft).
- Compliance: provide SOC2 artifacts + audit log access for the PoC environment.

Suggested timeline:
- Aug 5: Kickoff call to finalize success criteria & access.
- Aug 8-11: Provisioning + security handoff.
- Aug 12-30: PoC execution and weekly checkpoints.
- Aug 31: Final evaluation and next-step recommendations.

I've attached the PoC checklist and a link to the shared Drive with logs/requirements. If you confirm, I'll set the kickoff for Aug 5 or Aug 9 depending on your availability.

Ben

Attachments: poc-checklist-acme.docx
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-acme-poc

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, John Patel <john.patel@acme.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-04T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Recap: Discovery call — Deployment mode needs & PoC plan

Looping in our infra/security leads so we can get the SOC2 artifacts and network runbook ready for Acme. I'll own onboarding and weekly checkpoints. Notes for the team:

- Internal owners: Vivek (infra) will handle VPC/network and provisioning; Neha (security) will lead SOC2 evidence + security review.
- We should prepare: SOC2 summary + current auditor contact, encryption key management doc, and an architecture diagram for Dedicated vs Private deployment.
- Proposed kickoff: Aug 9 (Ben suggested Aug 5/9) — please confirm availability.
- I'll draft the kickoff agenda and send calendar invite once Samantha confirms date.

Ben — can you drop the HubSpot deal link and the mutual action plan into the calendar invite? Deal id: ACME-342.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
